name: CreateCycleTask

parameters.help_en: The task name. This is a custom string used to identify the periodic scan task
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，自定义字符串，用于标识周期性扫描任务
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:
VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN: virus scan.
IMAGE_SCAN: image scan.
EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN: emergency vulnerability scanning
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。
VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN：病毒扫描。
IMAGE_SCAN：镜像扫描。
EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN：应急漏洞扫描
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the scan period. Valid values:
day: day.
hour: hour
parameters.help_zh:
扫描周期的单位，取值：
day：天。
hour：小时
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The time of the first execution
parameters.name: first_date_str

parameters.help_en: The task start time, in hours
parameters.name: target_start_time

parameters.help_en: The task end time, in hours
parameters.name: target_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The extended information field.

Note: This parameter is actually required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns an error. The value is a JSON-formatted string that must contain at least the targetInfo array
parameters.help_zh:
扩展信息字段。

注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时API返回错误。值为JSON格式字符串，至少包含targetInfo数组
parameters.name: param

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the task. Valid values:
1: Enable.
0: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用。取值：
1：开启
0：关闭
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The source from which the task is added
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
